parameters.name: domain
parameters.description: The name of the Domain to scope to (Identity v3). Currently only domain names are supported, and not domain IDs.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: The ID of resource to be managed.

parameters.name: ip_version
parameters.description: The value can be 4 (IPv4 address) or 6 (IPv6 address). If this parameter is left blank, an IPv4 address is assigned.

parameters.name: ipv4_address
parameters.description: Specifies the obtained IPv4 EIP. The system automatically assigns an EIP if you do not specify it.

parameters.name: port_id
parameters.description: Specifies the port ID. This parameter is returned only when a private IP address is bound with the EIP.

parameters.name: project
parameters.description: The name of the Tenant (Identity v2) or Project (Identity v3). Currently only project names are supported, and not project IDs.

parameters.name: region
parameters.description: The region to which the project belongs.

parameters.name: shared_bandwidth_id
parameters.description: Specifies the ID of shared bandwidth.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether the given object should exist in Huawei Cloud. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: timeouts
parameters.description: The timeouts for each operations. Default: {}

parameters.name: user
parameters.description: The user name to login with. Currently only user names are supported, and not user IDs.

examples:
# create an eip and bind it to a port
- name: Create vpc
  hwc_network_vpc:
    cidr: "192.168.100.0/24"
    name: "ansible_network_vpc_test"
  register: vpc
- name: Create subnet
  hwc_vpc_subnet:
    gateway_ip: "192.168.100.32"
    name: "ansible_network_subnet_test"
    dhcp_enable: true
    vpc_id: "{{ vpc.id }}"
    cidr: "192.168.100.0/26"
  register: subnet
- name: Create a port
  hwc_vpc_port:
    subnet_id: "{{ subnet.id }}"
    ip_address: "192.168.100.33"
  register: port
- name: Create an eip and bind it to a port
  community.general.hwc_vpc_eip:
    type: "5_bgp"
    dedicated_bandwidth:
      charge_mode: "traffic"
      name: "ansible_test_dedicated_bandwidth"
      size: 1
    port_id: "{{ port.id }}"

return_values.name: create_time
return_values.description: Specifies the time (UTC time) when the EIP was assigned. Returned: success

return_values.name: dedicated_bandwidth
return_values.description: Specifies the dedicated bandwidth object. Returned: success

return_values.name: charge_mode
return_values.description: Specifies whether the bandwidth is billed by traffic or by bandwidth size. The value can be bandwidth or traffic. If this parameter is left blank or is null character string, default value bandwidth is used. For IPv6 addresses, the default parameter value is bandwidth outside China and is traffic in China. Returned: success

return_values.name: id
return_values.description: Specifies the ID of dedicated bandwidth. Returned: success

return_values.name: name
return_values.description: Specifies the bandwidth name. The value is a string of 1 to 64 characters that can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), hyphens (-), and periods (.). Returned: success

return_values.name: size
return_values.description: Specifies the bandwidth size. The value ranges from 1 Mbit/s to 2000 Mbit/s by default. (The specific range may vary depending on the configuration in each region. You can see the bandwidth range of each region on the management console.) The minimum unit for bandwidth adjustment varies depending on the bandwidth range. The details are as follows:. The minimum unit is 1 Mbit/s if the allowed bandwidth size ranges from 0 to 300 Mbit/s (with 300 Mbit/s included). The minimum unit is 50 Mbit/s if the allowed bandwidth size ranges 300 Mbit/s to 1000 Mbit/s (with 1000 Mbit/s included). The minimum unit is 500 Mbit/s if the allowed bandwidth size is greater than 1000 Mbit/s. Returned: success

return_values.name: enterprise_project_id
return_values.description: Specifies the enterprise project ID. Returned: success

return_values.name: ip_version
return_values.description: The value can be 4 (IPv4 address) or 6 (IPv6 address). If this parameter is left blank, an IPv4 address is assigned. Returned: success

return_values.name: ipv4_address
return_values.description: Specifies the obtained IPv4 EIP. The system automatically assigns an EIP if you do not specify it. Returned: success

return_values.name: ipv6_address
return_values.description: Specifies the obtained IPv6 EIP. Returned: success

return_values.name: port_id
return_values.description: Specifies the port ID. This parameter is returned only when a private IP address is bound with the EIP. Returned: success

return_values.name: private_ip_address
return_values.description: Specifies the private IP address bound with the EIP. This parameter is returned only when a private IP address is bound with the EIP. Returned: success

return_values.name: shared_bandwidth_id
return_values.description: Specifies the ID of shared bandwidth. Returned: success

return_values.name: type
return_values.description: Specifies the EIP type. Returned: success
